_schema.description: APS/MIDAS detector presets for build_detector_mask. Every numeric field is sourced from a real line in the MIDAS repo (/Users/b324240/Git/MIDAS); no invented values. NrPixelsY = detector width (fast/horizontal axis), NrPixelsZ = height (slow/vertical axis). px_um = pixel size in micrometres. DataType is the MIDAS file-format code (7 = tiff-uint8 = the MaskFile format itself; the code here is the TYPICAL raw-image DataType for this detector, not the mask). module_gaps is only populated where a concrete tiled layout exists in the repo (Pilatus 2M calibration example); null elsewhere rather than guessed.
_schema.datatype_codes: 1=uint16(GE binary, header auto->8192), 2=double, 3=float, 4=uint32, 5=int32, 6=tiff-uint32, 7=tiff-uint8(mask/bitmap), 8=hdf5, 9=tiff-uint16, 10=CBF. Source: FF_HEDM/src/archive/Integrator.c:520-542, GenMedianDark.c:153-172. NOTE: registry.py:159 '2=Pilatus' is INACCURATE docs; code 2 is double in all C.

eiger2_500k.notes: Dims/px from paper Table 1. DataType typical tiff-uint16; verify per dataset. Module gaps not encoded in MIDAS (no literals).

pilatus3_1m.notes: Pilatus CBF/TIFF commonly uses -1/-2 for gap/dead sentinels. Module gaps not hardcoded in MIDAS for this size.

pilatus3_2m.notes: The ONLY detector with a concrete tiled layout in the MIDAS repo (calibration example). PanelSizeZ 195 = Pilatus module height; PanelGapsZ 17 = inter-module gap; PanelGapsY 7 = true module boundary, 1 = intra-module split. DataType 6 (tiff-uint32) in the example.

pilatus3_6m.notes: Dims/px from paper Table 1. Module gaps not hardcoded in MIDAS for this size.

varex_2923.notes: Flat-panel (no module gaps). px auto-detected from .vrx/varex filename in AutoCalibrateZarr.

ge.notes: GE41RT-class area detector at APS. DataType 1 (uint16 binary) with an 8192-byte header (auto-set when DataType=1). 10-bit-stored x64: saturation at 65472 = 1023x64 (NF_HEDM_Handbook.md:729).

ge5.notes: GE variant stored as .ge5.h5 (HDF5, DataType 8). 200 um, ~71.7 keV in the benchmark. Dims inherit generic GE 2048^2.

hydra.notes: HYDRA is a multi-GE MODE (several GE panels, per-GE cake rows / LsdMean), not a distinct sensor. Per-panel dims inherit GE 2048^2. Mask per panel.
